Some circular debugging on the readBody hang across many steps, though pursued methodically with added logging/tracing rather than blind retries.

reasoning: The agent maintained a structured, continuously-updated view of pass-rate by subsystem (via the persistent analyze.py), tracked precise counts across the full horizon, detected regressions when touching shared code and reverted, and reallocated effort toward the largest failing categories — matching the level-8 anchor.
